parameters.name: AccountStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the member that you want to query.

*   **enabled**: managed.
*   **disabled**: not managed.
*   **disabling**: being deleted.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request. The system specifies this parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-member-accounts --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --source-ip 0.0.XX.XX --account-status enabled --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeMemberAccounts --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --AccountStatus enabled --SourceIp '0.0.XX.XX' --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
